title: Before the Dawn
lyrics: Night is heavy on the air
Shadows everywhere
Every heartbeat slowing down
Still we hold our ground
We are standing before the dawn
Holding on till the dark is gone
Even when the light feels far
We remember who we are
Every echo in the sky
Feels like a last goodbye
But beneath the fading blue
Something breaks through
We are standing before the dawn
Holding on till the dark is gone
Even when the light feels far
We remember who we are
When the silence starts to shake
That’s the moment we awake
Through the shadow, through the flame
We remain
We are standing before the dawn
Holding on till the dark is gone
Even when the light feels far
We remember who we are
